oa-broadcast.instruction: Use a (2,1) or larger column object array and a public row array to produce genuinely expanded rank-2 broadcast output. Use the broadcast results in the returned model output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-inplace-multiply-alias.instruction: Use whole-object-array *= and an alias to the same array. The returned result must depend on the alias observing the update; rebinding to a fresh array must change the output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-overlap-add.instruction: Use slice += with overlapping left and right object-array views and nonidentical initial cells. Use the updated overlapping cells in the output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-empty-subtract.instruction: Initialize an object array with Empty(), subtract ciphertext expressions via array -=, and use its resulting cells. Empty minus Expr is Expr, not negative Expr. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-cipher-product.instruction: Multiply two object arrays holding ciphertext expressions (not just scalar Expr multiplication) and use the product for the quadratic model. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-zero-dimension.instruction: Use a zero-dimensional object ndarray binary addition to obtain a scalar Expr. Use that scalar in the returned encrypted output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-inplace-subtract-alias.instruction: Use whole-array -= and a shared alias. Output must depend on the alias observing the update; replacing augmented assignment by a new-array binding must change output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-inplace-add-alias.instruction: Use whole-array += and a shared alias. Output must depend on the alias observing the update; replacing augmented assignment by a new-array binding must change output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-overlap-multiply.instruction: Use slice *= with overlapping ciphertext object-array views and nonidentical initial cells; use changed cells to implement the quadratic model. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.

oa-overlap-subtract.instruction: Use slice -= with overlapping left and right object-array views and nonidentical initial cells; use updated cells in the output. All required operations must affect output; no dead padding. Public constants may be referenced or derived. Keep the supplied model unchanged.
